The ENGLISH SENIOR CROSS-COUNTRY CHAMPIONSHIP was held at Apsley over a course almost knee-deep in snow. This was definitely not a fair test to the runners, although A.A. Robertson ran in really magnificent style and fully deserved his win.
Anthony Robertson became a Belgravian just a few weeks ago. He hails from South Africa but his father was born in Ireland and athletically, that is his nationality.
Anthony Robertson · Senior · Trk. Rd. C.C.

And just think, if Mike Kazimierski had been eligible we would have been home in 9:31:15 - a team time out of this world - not to mention the fact that just after the race Anthony Robertson (125th in 2:36:34) signed up for the Bels!
